dataflows

object

Data Datadog collects from GitHub Costs, keyed by dataflow id.

github-cloud-cost-metrics

object

GitHub costs for Actions, Packages, Copilot, storage, and other billed products, estimated from list prices and usage, including discounts when available. Used by Cloud Cost Management. Requires an enterprise or organization on GitHub's enhanced billing platform; without it this dataflow collects no data. This dataflow is always on and cannot be turned off, which is why it appears in responses only.

enabled

boolean

Whether Datadog collects this data. Always true, because this collection cannot be turned off.

status

object

Read-only collection status of a dataflow.

health

enum

Collection health of a single dataflow. Allowed enum values: DATAFLOW_HEALTH_OK,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_BROKEN,DATAFLOW_HEALTH_UNKNOWN

message

string

Human-readable detail, populated when the dataflow is not healthy.

updated_at

date-time

Time the status was last computed.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the GitHub Costs integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings configured on the GitHub Costs integration account.

enterprise_name [required]

string

Your GitHub enterprise slug, found on the enterprise settings page (e.g. enterprise-name), or an organization login (e.g. organization-name). An enterprise already covers every organization it owns.

tags

string

Comma-separated tags added to the collected costs, for example env:prod,team:example.

id [required]

string

Server-generated unique identifier of the GitHub Costs integration account.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

Data envelope for creating a GitHub Costs integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to create a GitHub Costs integration account.

authentication [required]

 <oneOf>

Authentication for creating the GitHub Costs integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. For an enterprise, use a personal access token (classic) from an Enterprise Admin with the manage_billing:enterprise and read:org scopes. For an organization, use a fine-grained personal access token created by an organization owner, with the organization as resource owner and read-only Administration permission.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token [required]

string

Secret token used to authenticate with GitHub.

name [required]

string

Human-readable name of the GitHub Costs integration account.

settings [required]

object

Settings for creating the GitHub Costs integration account.

enterprise_name [required]

string

Your GitHub enterprise slug, found on the enterprise settings page (e.g. enterprise-name), or an organization login (e.g. organization-name). An enterprise already covers every organization it owns.

tags

string

Comma-separated tags added to the collected costs, for example env:prod,team:example.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account

request.html:
data [required]

object

Data envelope for updating a GitHub Costs integration account.

attributes [required]

object

Writable attributes used to update a GitHub Costs integration account. Every field is optional; only the fields provided are changed.

authentication

 <oneOf>

Authentication for updating the GitHub Costs integration account. Exactly one method is set.

<auth_type=bearer_token>

object

Bearer token authentication. For an enterprise, use a personal access token (classic) from an Enterprise Admin with the manage_billing:enterprise and read:org scopes. For an organization, use a fine-grained personal access token created by an organization owner, with the organization as resource owner and read-only Administration permission. Only the fields provided are changed; omit token to keep the stored one.

auth_type [required]

enum

The authentication method type. Allowed enum values: bearer_token

default: bearer_token

token

string

Secret token used to authenticate with GitHub.

name

string

Human-readable name of the GitHub Costs integration account.

settings

object

Settings for updating the GitHub Costs integration account. Only the fields provided are changed.

enterprise_name

string

Your GitHub enterprise slug, found on the enterprise settings page (e.g. enterprise-name), or an organization login (e.g. organization-name). An enterprise already covers every organization it owns.

tags

string

Comma-separated tags added to the collected costs, for example env:prod,team:example.

id [required]

string

Unique identifier of the GitHub Costs integration account to update.

type [required]

enum

The type of the integration account resource. Always integration-account. Allowed enum values: integration-account

default: integration-account
